path_convention: All paths are relative to repository root.
collision_behavior: Freeze failed scene and its visible telemetry at first recorded collision segment end sample; source trace is preserved.

notes: Inspected decoded frames at playback 3.40 s, 6.20 s, and 19.00 s.
Both emergency samples explicitly say EMERGENCY POLICY · UNCERTIFIED while the collision-clear skill count remains separately visible.
The moving obstacle follows its recorded centers and no fictitious wind field is displayed.
Reinspected the final three-frame contact sheet and a native-resolution arrival/probe frame: the open horizontal goal ring leaves the physical drone visible at arrival.
limitations: Some forward skill endpoints can reach the main camera boundary during fast flight; the fixed-scale neutral-reference insets preserve the complete recorded fan.

renderer_validation.scope: Focused renderer suite, including both actual MuJoCo modes, payload geometry, collision freeze, and open goal center.
